title: pentaschistis elegans
intro: Pentaschistis elegans, commonly known as mountain grass, is a type of flowering plant native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the relief of pain and the protection of cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of Pentaschistis elegans include its ability to act as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory agent, as well as its potential to exhibit immunomodulatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and other compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
